rows.label: bf03090100_0010
rows.name: What's wrong? Aren't you Heaven's Holy Grail?

rows.label: bf03090100_0040
rows.name:
That's all you've got?
You call that 'power'?

rows.label: bf03090100_0050
rows.name:
Then I'll show you the power
Homura and I have!

rows.label: bf03090100_0070
rows.name: Of course! You're so slow it makes me yawn.

rows.label: bf03090100_0100
rows.name:
Rex, wait! I can't
supply power this fast!

rows.label: bf03090100_0110
rows.name: Nowhere left to run! Eat this!

rows.label: bf03090100_0150
rows.name:
You're new to being a
Driver, aren't you, kid?

rows.label: bf03090100_0170
rows.name:
They temporarily store the energy
sent to them by their Blade in their weapon...

rows.label: bf03090100_0175
rows.name: and use that energy to perform Arts.

rows.label: bf03090100_0180
rows.name:
There's a natural limit to
how much you can store.

rows.label: bf03090100_0190
rows.name:
If you fire off Arts without thinking ahead,
even if you're Heaven's Holy Grail...

rows.label: bf03090100_0222
rows.name:
I work as a mercenary in
the village up ahead.

rows.label: bf03090100_0250
rows.name:
As thanks for letting me enjoy the power of
Heaven's Holy Grail, I'll treat you to a meal.

rows.label: bf03090100_0270
rows.name:
I realized it when I took
his attack earlier...

rows.label: bf03090100_0280
rows.name:
It seems he never intended to
fight seriously from the start.

rows.label: bf03090100_0290
rows.name: What's the deal with that old guy...
